title: Case: Recipient wants delivery held during a short absence
context: The shipment is at a depot and has not entered the delivery route. Dispatch permits a three-day hold for this service.
initial_request: I am away and return on 2028-02-12. Please hold the parcel and release it on 2028-02-12, not earlier.

events.body: DL-6848 is in depot stock. This service allows a hold up to three calendar days before routing. A confirmed release date is required.
I am away and return on 2028-02-12. Please hold the parcel and release it on 2028-02-12, not earlier.
Please apply the eligible three-day hold to DL-6848, with release on 2028-02-12 as requested in Piran’s verified order thread. Confirm the stock and routing status.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Dispatch, Vanecroft Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
No delivery date or physical receipt follows merely from the planned release.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-010: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
